name: Pradhan Mantri Ujjwala Yojana (PMUY)
description: PMUY is a Government of India scheme intended to make clean LPG cooking fuel available to eligible poor households, especially rural and deprived households that may otherwise use traditional cooking fuels.
benefits: Eligible beneficiaries receive a deposit-free LPG connection. Official PMUY information says the support covers the cylinder security deposit, regulator, hose, consumer card, and installation-related charges; the first refill and stove are also provided free of cost under the stated benefits.
eligibility: The applicant must be an adult woman aged 18 or above from a poor household under the prescribed declaration process, and the household must not already have an LPG connection from an Oil Marketing Company. Current scheme rules and verification determine final eligibility.
documents: Official PMUY information lists KYC, family-composition documentation or permitted alternative declaration, Aadhaar for the beneficiary and relevant adult family members, proof of address where applicable, and bank account number with IFSC code.
application_process: Apply for a PMUY connection through the official PMUY services or an authorised LPG distributor. Complete the required KYC and verification steps.

eligibility_criteria.target_group: Adult women from BPL / SC / ST / PMAY households without LPG connection
